verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird's own Reach page lists its offices across several countries, including Casablanca, Sydney, Beijing, Hong Kong, Shanghai and Singapore. Its practice pages also cite a London office, a key European venture-capital presence and one of the largest patent teams in Europe. So a founder can expand into these jurisdictions without retaining a second firm. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of the office network, a complete country list, and clarity on which offices practise local law versus operate as affiliated entities (e.g. Bird & Bird ATMD LLP in Singapore).

support.subject: As a founder, the firm states its own offices or qualified practices in multiple countries, so expansion does not immediately mean a second firm
